title: Tank fill timeout
shortDescription: Wash tank did not fill in allowed time.
fullDescription: Champion DH/UH detected tank failed to fill. Check supply and inlet valve.

title: Tank heat fault
fullDescription: Heater timed out. Scale or element failure.

title: Booster heat fault
fullDescription: Final rinse booster timeout. Scale or element failure.

title: Drain timeout
fullDescription: Drain pump or floor drain blocked.

title: Conveyor jam
fullDescription: Rack stuck or conveyor motor overload on conveyor models.

title: Door/hood switch fault
fullDescription: Hood or door switch did not engage.

title: Wash motor overload
fullDescription: Wash pump drew excess current. Check pump.

title: Control fault
fullDescription: Power cycle. If persistent, replace board.
